compare.exclude_fields_reason: Cross-language-RNG-safety exclusion (mirrors Byrdonis/Mawler pattern). Bygone Effigy's initial INITIAL_SLEEP state is deterministic (no RAND branch on startup) so the intent triple is technically stable, but the Python pin's DSL driver consumes RNG bits during state initialization that diverge from Rust's Xoshiro256++. Keeping the structural shape-lock independent of intent values; HP/max_hp/pile counts/keys all byte-locked.
